selectionRule: These three design tasks each depend only on B01-C contract_accepted in the pinned graph. Preparability is not proof of operational admission, absence of another active run, semantic acceptance or runtime completion. Ekwip must deduplicate on task/source/candidate before execution.

tasks.title: Food data, recipes and controlled import - design and contracts
tasks.priorityReason: Defines food/version/measurement contracts before menu generation; independent of unfinished B02-C and T001-3 in the pinned DAG.
deliverables: Existing food schema to ingredient/component/recipe/portion version map, with evidence of absent/legacy fields.
Versioned import request/result DTOs: source row identity, units, raw quantity, purchase yield, finished weight, nutrition evidence state and publication review.
Executable DB-M fixtures showing draft-only import, critical-unknown rejection and immutable recipe/cost versions.

cases.exercise: Import nutrition field omitted or marked unknown
cases.expected: Keep unknown; never normalize to zero; block critical unresolved publication

cases.exercise: Raw net ingredient weight and purchase yield differ from measured finished weight
cases.expected: Preserve three distinct quantities and basis; no generic raw-to-finished declaration

cases.exercise: Update ingredient/component after recipe version is published
cases.expected: Create new versions and impact analysis; old recipe and cost evidence unchanged

cases.exercise: Import worksheet with publish flag/formula pretending validation passed
cases.expected: Create draft, server validates/recalculates; only authorized review publishes

cases.exercise: Allergen taxonomy includes wheat/gluten and crustaceans/molluscs
cases.expected: Maintain separate relationships and cross-contact/evidence states; no9chip restriction

cases.exercise: One recipe is assigned to two current plans using normalized midpoint macros
cases.expected: Reject invalid membership; preserve stored bands and whole-day feasibility

missingDecisions.needed: Pilot recipe/portion/nutrition/allergen evidence, costing, shelf life and packaging. Synthetic contracts can proceed; food data cannot be certified.
Midpoint/display rounding convention only. Do not normalize ratified D-065 bands or block all data-model preparation.

interfaces: B08-C consumes immutable recipe/portion versions and validated nutrition/evidence; no runtime dependency added to backlog.
acceptanceEvidence: Versioned contract files and source traceability
Executable positive/negative fixtures with exact candidate SHA and reports
Independent semantic review and unresolved decisions
External acceptance receipt; structural checker alone is insufficient

tasks.title: Production, preparation, incidents and delivery - design and contracts
tasks.priorityReason: Supplies the delivery adapter and operations contracts explicitly missing from B02-C; contract preparation depends only on B01-C.
deliverables: Versioned production/amendment/acknowledgement and delivery state/event DTOs.
Explicit list/confirm/fail/correct/reconcile interface with assigned-resource scope, minimum fields and event identity.
Freeze/safety incident and at-least-once consumer fixture matrix; G-ROUND decision packet with bounded alternatives, no invented default.

cases.exercise: Consumption J with18-22slot and last-call rule
cases.expected: Window begins23:00J-2 and ends05:00J-1; production/delivery/consumption dates distinct

cases.exercise: Unsafe recipe/profile change arrives after freeze
cases.expected: Create blocking incident; stop preparation/handover; never silently regenerate or override safety

cases.exercise: Administrator attempts post-cutoff logistics without dedicated scoped grant
cases.expected: Deny; when allowed require reason, audit, amended production version and acknowledgement

cases.exercise: Driver requests other round delivery or outside visibility window
cases.expected: Deny; same checks apply direct APIs and exports

cases.exercise: Concurrent confirm and retry after unknown external outcome
cases.expected: Single authoritative transition/event, unique consumers, reconcile ambiguity; no duplicate reward/notice

cases.exercise: Correction changes a prior delivered record
cases.expected: Append correction with dedicated permission/reason; preserve original event and totals reconciliation

cases.exercise: Reconcile planned120/prepared118/delivered115/failed3
cases.expected: Keep planned-minus-prepared2 visible; define denominator and missing-state counts rather than report unaccounted0 ambiguously

missingDecisions.needed: Who assigns/reassigns rounds; exact useful visibility interval and minimum contact/bag/notes fields; correction ownership. Deny unspecified access until resolved.
Compensation/credit effects, if any, follow accepted lifecycle rules. Delivery failure cannot invent credit/refund.

interfaces: B02-C consumes exact adapter version and permissions once reviewed, without giving all drivers global access.
B12-C and referral consumers receive one authoritative delivery event; consumer effects are idempotent.
acceptanceEvidence: Versioned contract files and source traceability
Executable positive/negative fixtures with exact candidate SHA and reports
Independent semantic review and unresolved decisions
External acceptance receipt; structural checker alone is insufficient

tasks.title: Verified email and transactional communications - design and contracts
tasks.priorityReason: Prepares communication proof/outbox contracts independently of provider onboarding and staff contract correction.
deliverables: Versioned account/purpose/operation-bound verification proof contract and Send-SMS hook boundary.
Minimal transaction notification DTO with event-channel-recipient idempotency, locale/template version, consent requirement and provider outcome states.
Negative fixtures for replay, stale renewal state, recipient mismatch, push opt-in and ambiguous sends; no real message sends.

cases.exercise: Email proof replay, cross-account or cross-purpose use
cases.expected: Deny; atomic single-use consumption bound to account/purpose/operation

cases.exercise: OTP hook invoked without trusted signature or for unknown purpose
cases.expected: Reject before provider send; rate/abuse policy preserved

cases.exercise: Two workers process same event-recipient-channel tuple
cases.expected: One consumer effect; different recipient/channel is separate; ambiguous result reconciled before repeat

cases.exercise: Push recipient has no current opt-in or revoked device association
cases.expected: No push; no inference from WhatsApp/email consent

cases.exercise: Delayed renewal notification after cancellation/trial/no valid mandate
cases.expected: Read actual authoritative state; no misleading renewal claim and no trial auto-renew

cases.exercise: Automatic dispatcher encounters admission notice
cases.expected: Preserve manual launch admission notices; do not generalize transactional automation

cases.exercise: Notification payload contains phone/token/health/history or wrong locale fallback
cases.expected: Reject/redact forbidden fields; render reviewed FR/EN template with no invented content

missingDecisions.needed: OTP/WhatsApp/email suppliers, approved templates, secret-manager references, sender domains and failure runbooks. Contract adapters remain synthetic.
Assisted recovery evidence when factors lost. This contract cannot approve delivery-knowledge shortcut.
Purpose/retention/processor locations and consent rules for release; no blanket permission to send.

interfaces: Preserve accepted SEC-A/SEC-C proof and revocation invariants; do not rewrite their fixtures.
Consume B01-I outbox and B11 authoritative events; no duplicate orchestration engine.
